jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Collect and review financial data from federal and local government entities.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Classify financial data in accordance with GFSM 2014 standards.
Maintain financial databases and supporting documentation.
Support the analysis and classification of government-related entities (GREs).
Prepare financial statistics, reports, tables, and presentations.
Coordinate data requests with relevant government entities and stakeholders.
Support IMF missions, meetings, and workshops.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or Statistics.
0–3 years of relevant work experience.
Strong analytical, numerical, and data interpretation skills.
Knowledge of financial data analysis and reporting.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Good written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.
